legacyOptions.textFormat: A new catalog snapshot was exported for the web server.

spec.description: What Radix, the collector, does: what it asked for by endpoint, and, when it fetches through Cortex, how much of it Cortex answered from its store and what reached the university; what changed, its cycles and the snapshots it publishes. From GET /metrics of each instance's Radix (job radix) and of Cortex (job cortex). Provisioned from deploy/config/monitoring/grafana/dashboards - edit there.

spec.title: Failed requests
spec.description: Requests without a final answer (anything but 200 and 404), retries included. Through Cortex an error of Cortex itself counts here too; a page Cortex has not stored when it is asked offline (offline_miss) does not: it is skipped, not failed.

spec.title: Reached the university
spec.description: Requests that reached b-tu.de, QIS or OPUS in the selected range: what a Radix without Cortex sent, plus what Cortex fetched from these hosts for every client.

spec.expr: (sum(increase(radix_crawl_requests_total{stack=~"$stack"}[$__range]) unless on(stack) (radix_crawl_via_cortex{stack=~"$stack"} == 1)) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cortex_upstream_requests_total{job="cortex", host=~"qis.b-tu.de|www.b-tu.de|b-tu.de|opus4.kobv.de"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Answered from Cortex's store
spec.description: Of Radix's requests to Cortex in the selected range, the share Cortex answered from its store without asking the university. Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: Pages changed, 24 h
spec.description: Archived pages whose content changed (or that are new) in the last 24 hours, read from the archive itself: survives restarts.

spec.title: Snapshots published
spec.description: New catalog snapshots exported for the web server in the selected range. Only when the content changed.

spec.title: Current snapshot
spec.description: Age of the snapshot each instance offers the web server. It only gets newer when the catalog's content changed, so a day or two is normal.

spec.title: Errors in the log
spec.description: Log records at level ERROR in the selected range (a human is needed; alert "betula: ERROR in the logs"). The events are listed below.

spec.title: Requests by endpoint
spec.description: HTTP requests Radix sent per endpoint, retries included, per bar: to Cortex when it fetches through Cortex, else to the university.

spec.title: Requests per endpoint, total
spec.description: The same, summed over the selected range.

spec.title: Health
spec.description: GET /healthz of each instance's Radix: unhealthy without a snapshot to serve, after two failed cycles in a row, or without a successful cycle for 26 h. Only an instance that crawls (mode run) reports it; an offline one shows its snapshot below.

spec.title: Answers by status code
spec.description: The status of each answer. Through Cortex it is the university's status as Cortex stored it; error means no answer, or an error of Cortex itself; offline_miss a page Cortex had not stored when it was asked offline (RADIX_CRAWL=cortex-offline).

spec.title: Answer time p95 by endpoint
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time from request to the end of the body. Through Cortex: a hit from its store (milliseconds), or Cortex's queue for the host plus the university's answer. The university's own answer time is in „University answer time p95" below. Above 15 s a request is logged as crawl.slow.

spec.title: Data received by endpoint
spec.description: Bytes of the answers Radix received per endpoint (from Cortex or the university).

spec.title: How Cortex answered Radix
spec.description: Radix's requests to Cortex per bar, by how Cortex answered: from its store, or fetched from the university (not stored yet, stored copy older than Radix's max age, refresh). Counted on the instance that answered; a request a follower passed to the leader counts once. Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: From Cortex's store, by endpoint
spec.description: Per endpoint, the share of Radix's requests in the selected range that Cortex answered from its store. Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (source) (increase(cortex_requests_total{job="cortex", source=~"module_catalog|module_page|qis_module_list|qis_fues_list|qis_module_page|qis_tree|qis_event_entry|qis_event|statute", result=~"hit|not_modified"}[$__range])) / sum by (source) (increase(cortex_requests_total{job="cortex", source=~"module_catalog|module_page|qis_module_list|qis_fues_list|qis_module_page|qis_tree|qis_event_entry|qis_event|statute", result!="forwarded"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Reached the university, by host
spec.description: What Cortex sent to b-tu.de, QIS and OPUS per bar, retries and redirects included, for every client. A Radix without Cortex shows its requests above instead. Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: University answers by code
spec.description: The status of the university's answers to Cortex; error means no answer (network error, timeout). Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: University answer time p95
spec.description: 95th percentile of the university's own answer time, measured by Cortex from request to the end of the body. Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: Hosts paused by Cortex
spec.description: Cortex stops asking a host for a while after 10 failures in a row, or when the host answers 429/503 with Retry-After. Meanwhile Radix's requests for that host fail (Radix asks with stale=never). Cortex serves every instance, so these numbers are not split by the Instance filter.

spec.title: Mode
spec.description: run: crawls the university and builds the catalog. cortex-offline: runs its cycles on what Cortex has stored and fetches nothing (RADIX_CRAWL=cortex-offline, the canary). serve-snapshot: offline (RADIX_CRAWL=off), only serves the snapshot it has. Exactly one instance of a site should crawl.

spec.title: Pages by outcome
spec.description: What became of every page fetched: changed (new, or another content than the archived one), unchanged, not_found (404), failed (given up after three attempts). The event search counts each event it lists. offline_miss: Cortex had not stored the page when it was asked offline; it stays as archived.

spec.title: Changed pages by endpoint
spec.description: Pages whose content changed (or that are new), per endpoint and bar.

spec.title: The archive, by endpoint
spec.description: What the raw page archive holds per endpoint, read from the database (once a minute): pages, pages the server answers with 404, pages fetched and changed in the last 24 hours, and how long ago the newest and the oldest fetch were. Module pages are read weekly, QIS descriptions, the tree and event pages monthly: an oldest fetch beyond about 31 days means a stage falls behind.

spec.title: Catalog builds
spec.description: Every cycle builds the catalog from the archive. changed: the published content differs, so a snapshot is validated and exported; unchanged: nothing to publish. Module rows changed: rows of the QIS module table that read differently, whose descriptions are fetched again.

spec.title: What the catalog holds
spec.description: Counts of the last build. A sudden drop usually means a page layout changed and a parser no longer recognises it (validation would then refuse to publish).

spec.title: Removed by retention
spec.description: Events past their last date (after 30 days) and archived pages nothing leads to any more (after 7 days).

spec.title: Cycles by result
spec.description: ok: everything ran. degraded: a crawl stage failed, the published data is intact but may age. failed: build, validation or export failed, the previous snapshot stays. interrupted: stopped (deploy).

spec.title: Stage duration
spec.description: How long the last run of each stage took. The crawl stages are long in the off-peak window, the build takes about 20 s.

spec.title: Last successful cycle
spec.description: Time since the last cycle that ended ok or degraded. A cycle starts every 30 min; above 26 h /healthz turns unhealthy.

spec.title: Failed or skipped stages
spec.description: failed: the stage logged stage.failed (ERROR). skipped: a bulk stage outside the off-peak window, or the export when the content did not change - both normal.

spec.title: Cycle running
spec.description: When Radix was working.

spec.title: Memory of Radix
spec.description: The container of each instance's Radix (limits: 1 GB, 1 CPU): working set.

spec.title: CPU of Radix
spec.description: The container of each instance's Radix (limits: 1 GB, 1 CPU): share of one processor.

spec.title: Web server's snapshot requests
spec.description: Folia asks every minute whether there is a new snapshot: 304 = it has it already, 200 on catalog.db = a download (after a new export or a restart), 503 = no snapshot yet.

spec.title: Warnings and errors by event
spec.description: Log records at WARN and ERROR per event name (docs/radix/operations.md, section 2). Retries, slow answers and 404s are WARN; given-up pages, failed stages and failed checks are ERROR.

spec.title: Radix log: warnings and errors
spec.description: The newest WARN and ERROR lines of Radix. Everything else: dashboard Logs, service <stack>_radix.

spec.title: Failed cycles in a row
spec.description: Cycles whose build, validation or export failed since the last good one; the previous snapshot stays current. 2 or more = unhealthy.

spec.title: Now
spec.description: Whether a cycle is running right now; otherwise when the next one starts.

spec.title: Off-peak window
spec.description: Between 01:00 and 06:00 local time the bulk stages crawl (module index, module pages, QIS descriptions, tree). By day only the event search and the event pages it has news for.

spec.title: Fetches through
spec.description: Whether this instance's crawl goes through Cortex (RADIX_CORTEX_URL) or asks the university itself, and whether it reads Cortex's store alone (RADIX_CRAWL=cortex-offline: nothing reaches the university). An instance that serves its snapshot offline fetches nothing.

spec.expr: max by (stack) (radix_crawl_via_cortex{stack=~"$stack"}) + (max by (stack) (radix_crawl_cortex_offline{stack=~"$stack"}) or max by (stack) (radix_crawl_via_cortex{stack=~"$stack"}) * 0)

spec.title: Requests Radix sent
spec.description: HTTP requests Radix sent in the selected range, retries included. Through Cortex they go to Cortex, which answers most of them from its store (below, „Through Cortex"); without it they go to b-tu.de / QIS.

spec.title: What Radix asked for, by endpoint
Radix

spec.name: stack
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: The instances whose Radix is scraped. Only one instance of a site crawls; the others serve their snapshot offline.
